title: Restaurant Review Analysis Report
executive_summary: An analysis of 14 customer reviews identified inconsistencies in food quality as a primary driver of negative experiences, stemming from operational variance during peak service hours.
key_findings: Inconsistent food quality was noted in 21.4% of the analyzed reviews, leading to negative customer experiences.

root_causes.pattern: Inconsistent food quality leading to negative experiences for some customers
root_causes.cause: Variability in kitchen preparation and lack of standardized quality control during peak hours

recommendations.issue: Inconsistent food quality during peak hours due to lack of standardized preparation and quality control.
recommendations.action: Implement strict kitchen standard operating procedures (SOPs), including mandatory recipe cards at every station, plating reference photos on the pass, and assigning a dedicated expeditor during peak hours to perform quality checks before dishes leave the kitchen.
recommendations.expected_impact: Reduction in food variance across shifts, lower rates of returned dishes, and improved overall customer satisfaction scores.

limitations: Small sample size of 14 reviews may not fully represent the sentiment of all customers.
Analysis relies on unsolicited online reviews which may be skewed toward extreme experiences.
